test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Seeing my messy room, my mother taught me to keep everything in order. Now my room is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **spick and span**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the phrases given in the options section.

 
 
• **On demand**: As soon as or whenever required. (जितनी जल्दी या जब भी आवश्यक हो)
